mapper.update: INSERT INTO doctor (doctorName, username, password, phone, email, cityName, hospitalName, departmentName, introduction) VALUES (#{doctorName}, #{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{cityName}, #{hospitalName}, #{departmentName}, #{introduction}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE doctorName = VALUES(doctorName), cityName = VALUES(cityName), hospitalName = VALUES(hospitalName), departmentName = VALUES(departmentName), introduction = VALUES(introduction)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM doctor WHERE phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM doctor WHERE phone = #{phone} AND password = #{password} LIMIT 1
